findings.title: Acceptance Criteria for Deliverables
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies the acceptance testing criteria for the deliverables, which include functional tests, performance benchmarks, and network integration tests, along with the requirement to report discrepancies within a specified timeframe.
evidence_excerpts: Acceptance testing included: functional tests, performance benchmarks, and network integration tests.

findings.title: Service Level and Performance Commitments
findings.rationale: The vendor commits to providing 24x7 remote and onsite support for troubleshooting and preventive maintenance, which is a key service level commitment.
evidence_excerpts: Primevolta provides 24x7 remote and onsite support for troubleshooting and preventive maintenance.

findings.title: Service Performance Measurement and Reporting
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies that acceptance testing included functional tests, performance benchmarks, and network integration tests, which are methods of measuring service performance under the agreement.
evidence_excerpts: Acceptance testing included: functional tests, performance benchmarks, and network integration tests.
